visions.wristbands: none; Keen has not yet received the cuffs in the pier vision
visions.style: Aida’s POV fills the entire frame inside the rose-quartz vision bubble, with only a soft glowing orb edge and pink haze at the margins, no sanctuary visible outside it.
visions.materialize: Drifting rose-quartz light coalesces out of soft darkness into the later pier image, then dissolves back into the bowl tone.

recurring.name: Fuzzby
recurring.appearance: The bigger male bee, pollen-sack legs, expressive chest-out superhero pride, chaotic but never defeated.
recurring.orientation: When paired with Zenny, Fuzzby holds frame-left and Zenny frame-right; Fuzzby’s failures recover instantly into pride.

recurring.name: Zenny
recurring.appearance: The smaller female bee, calm design cues, neat pollen work, still deadpan face with tiny rationed smiles.
recurring.orientation: When paired with Fuzzby, Zenny holds frame-right and frames his chaos with stillness.

recurring.name: Squeaky
recurring.appearance: A small dolphin with quick chirps and clicks, playful arcs through water, no words and no crystal.
recurring.orientation: Circles and returns around Keen as a game until the rescue turns the play into need.

recurring.name: Keen's Mum
recurring.appearance: Adult female bear the same size as Aida, natural pale-blue fur, gold scalloped collar, light-blue bow, no clothes.
recurring.orientation: Her care is shown through held paws, softened eyes, and letting Keen leave rather than holding him back.

persistent.in: Keen’s sailboat, then carried through the storm if still attached
on Keen’s wrists after the award

lost.name: Keen’s map
lost.reason: The storm wind snatches it from Keen’s paws and it vanishes into the rain.

lost.name: Keen’s sailboat
lost.reason: The storm takes the boat during the rescue; by shore arrival it is gone.

items.name: Keen’s father’s cuffs, vacant state
items.appearance: Gold cuffs with band colour F1B43F, empty kite-shaped bezel, dark vacant recess 1A1A1A; no gems until Scene 9.

items.name: Aquamarine crystal gems
items.appearance: Faceted aquamarine kite gems, glowing azure around #47DFFF, splitting from one hovering crystal into two matched stones.

items.name: Keen’s map
items.appearance: Small rolled paper map, handled and rechecked, then turned upside down before being lost.

items.name: Keen’s sailboat
items.appearance: Neat little wooden sailboat with mast, sail, rope, and packed supplies, safe at the pier then tiny and vulnerable at sea.

items.name: Ragged drift net
items.appearance: Dark torn netting wrapped tight around Squeaky’s tail underwater, dragged by current until Keen tears it free.

items.name: Aida’s crystal bowl
items.appearance: Polished crystal singing bowl with wand, producing a low shimmering tone and rose-quartz light.

worldState.change: The first distant thunder pressure touches the playful meadow by the end of the scene.
Rain and wind now push through the trees, opening visibility toward the storm sea.
The cove becomes the rescue lookout under storm rain and wind.
The storm peaks; Squeaky is trapped, Keen dives, the net tears, and the boat is lost.
The storm begins to clear; the beach becomes a safe receiving place for Keen.
Rain-washed gathering space becomes the place where Keen’s courage is witnessed and the Aquamarine crystal settles into his cuffs.
The beach settles into golden-hour peace, keeping visible wet traces of the storm.
